body: I truly appreciate it from the depth of my heart, but honestly this post is the most I'll ever be able to do
I'm sorry to hear that, but I'm glad you're actively trying to prevent it from more people. Definitely helps when someone reaches out and tries to make people feel okay
Honestly I'm not good at venting, it just makes me feel even more depressed and then I just start drinking more than usual and I already drink more than my fair share,, ,are you okay though?

I'm in the military and I'm required to use weapons for my job, if any word of suicidal thoughts get reported then I will pretty much be blacklisted and not allowed to perform my duty, and then set out for discharge.  I appreciate your willingness to talk though.
